theme: Amino acid catabolism: threonine, glycine, aromatic and proline
core_role: The shared pathways frame threonine-to-glycine catabolism and glyoxylate/organic acid turnover as the generic amino acid degradation core, which the additional pathways extend to aromatic (phenylalanine, tyrosine) and proline catabolism.

theme: Hormonal and energy-sensing control of hepatic glucose-lipid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the regulatory signalling layer (glucagon-PKA, AMPK-ChREBP, LXR) that sets lipid and fat-storage fates, read here as the switch that also tunes gluconeogenesis versus glycolysis.

theme: Centrosome, spindle and cytokinesis machinery in mitosis
core_role: The shared pathways are the mitotic division apparatus (PLK1/AURKA-driven centrosome separation, spindle assembly, checkpoint and cytokinesis), framed within a broader centrosome-microtubule cycle that also governs centrioles, cilia and neuronal migration.

theme: Inflammasome-driven IL-1 family cytokine processing
core_role: The shared pathways are the NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activation and IL-1 precursor processing step, framed as the maturation/release mechanism for IL-1 family inflammatory cytokines.

theme: Leukocyte chemotaxis and homing to lymphoid organs
core_role: The shared pathways describe chemokine (CCR7) and S1P-guided migration of dendritic cells and lymphocytes into and within lymphoid tissues, with integrin-mediated adhesion as the supporting step.

theme: SLC6 monoamine neurotransmitter reuptake transporters and their disorders
core_role: The shared pathways cover norepinephrine transporter (SLC6A2) reuptake and its deficiency, framed as catecholamine clearance alongside the parallel dopamine transporter (SLC6A3) defects.

theme: NK cell and cytotoxic lymphocyte killing
core_role: The shared pathways are the NK/cytotoxic effector machinery (degranulation, granzyme-mediated killing, cytokine production), framed as cellular defense triggered by NK receptor activation.

theme: E2F-driven cell cycle progression and DNA replication initiation
core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F/CDK-controlled G1/S and G2/M cell cycle programme, read here as the transcriptional driver of origin licensing and replication initiation.

theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are the Trk (NTRK3/TRKA) receptor-proximal adaptor cascades (FRS2, ARMS, Ras, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, CREB) that relay neurotrophin signals to transcription and survival.

theme: Lysosomal catabolism of glycosphingolipids and oligosaccharides
core_role: The shared pathways are the lysosomal degradation of gangliosides and glycans and its storage disorders (GM2 gangliosidosis, sialidosis), framed as lysosomal hydrolase function.

theme: Axon guidance
core_role: The shared pathways are the guidance-cue signalling (semaphorin-plexin, netrin) that steers axon extension and innervation, of which specific neuron-type axon guidance is an instance.

theme: Actin dynamics for membrane ruffling, motility and macropinocytosis
core_role: The shared pathways are the actin polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking machinery, used here to build ruffles and protrusions that drive macropinocytosis, podosomes and motility.

theme: Actin filament turnover and remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are actin filament disassembly and network remodelling (severing, capping, crosslinking, caspase cleavage), framed as the turnover counterpart that enables polymerization-driven ruffling and motility.

theme: Pancreatic and urogenital gland development and gonad differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways cover lineage specification and branching morphogenesis of glandular epithelia (pancreas, prostate, reproductive tract), read alongside gonadal development and sex determination programmes.

theme: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and skin barrier formation
core_role: The shared pathways regulate the balance of keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and death in the epidermis, framed as the upstream control leading to cornification and skin barrier formation.

theme: Lipoylated mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes
core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage) sharing DLD, framed as mitochondrial 2-oxoglutarate and lysine/glycine catabolic metabolism.

theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis and PAPS-dependent sulfonation
core_role: The shared pathways combine thyroid hormone generation and transport with PAPS synthesis, sulfonation and selenium metabolism, framed as thyroid hormone production and activity control that also needs iodide uptake and H2O2 generation.

theme: Hexosamine and sialic acid metabolism supplying glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways are the hexosamine and sialic acid pathways that produce UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid, framed as donor-sugar supply for protein N-glycosylation.

theme: Cadherin-mediated adherens junctions
core_role: The shared pathways are calcium-dependent cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) adhesion and its trafficking and degradation, framed as assembly and maintenance of adherens junctions.

theme: Ras-ERK-RSK signalling and its negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways are the activating arm of Ras-MAPK signalling to RSK and p38, framed against phosphatase-mediated negative regulation of the ERK cascade.

theme: Xenobiotic and mycotoxin detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are cytochrome P450-mediated toxin metabolism (aflatoxin activation/detoxification, polyketides, steroids), framed as phase I of general xenobiotic detoxification.

theme: Death receptor-mediated apoptosis and necroptosis
core_role: The shared pathways are extrinsic death-receptor signalling (Fas, TRAIL, TNF) and its positive/negative control, framed as the caspase-8/c-FLIP/RIPK1 decision between apoptosis and necroptosis.

theme: Cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling and contractility
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of SERCA-mediated calcium reuptake and release in the sarcoplasmic reticulum, framed as the control of cardiac contraction force and relaxation.

theme: Nutrient and energy sensing by mTORC1
core_role: The shared pathways are mTORC1 regulation by amino acids and LKB1-AMPK energy status, framed as the TSC-Rheb-gated growth control switch.

theme: ESCRT-mediated endosomal sorting and receptor downregulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the ESCRT/multivesicular body membrane-fission machinery, framed as sorting of internalised ubiquitinated receptors (EGFR) for lysosomal degradation, plus exosome and viral release.

theme: Eye morphogenesis and retinal vascular development
core_role: The shared pathways cover camera-type eye tissue morphogenesis (lens, retina, cornea, iris) and Wnt-dependent retinal vasculature and barrier formation, framed as eye development broadened to optic nerve and adnexa.

theme: Fructose and glycerol metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are hepatic fructose and glycerol utilisation and their inborn errors, framed as carbon entry points into gluconeogenesis.

theme: Type 2 immunity: Th2, eosinophils and mast cells
core_role: The shared pathways are Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13 production and eosinophil/mast cell effector responses, framed as the type 2 response initiated by IL-33 alarmin signalling.

theme: GABA synthesis, transport and degradation
core_role: The shared pathways cover the GABA lifecycle (synthesis, release, reuptake, degradation), framed as inhibitory neurotransmitter handling including vesicular loading.

theme: FGF receptor signalling and oncogenic FGFR variants
core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR ligand activation and downstream adaptor cascades (FRS2, SHC, PLCgamma) including activating mutants, framed as FGFR signalling across isoforms, splicing and amplification.

theme: VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are endothelial activation, proliferation, migration and branching in sprouting angiogenesis, framed as the response to VEGF and TGF-beta growth factor production.

theme: p53/RB-controlled cell cycle checkpoints and arrest
core_role: The shared pathways are the cell cycle checkpoint and arrest machinery (p53, RB-E2F, DREAM, CDK inhibition and degradation), framed as the response to DNA damage and senescence.

theme: Kidney development and nephron formation
core_role: The shared pathways are early kidney induction (intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme differentiation, renal vesicle), framed as the start of nephron segment morphogenesis.

theme: Selective autophagy of organelles
core_role: The shared pathways are selective organelle autophagy (ER-phagy, pexophagy, mitophagy, nucleophagy) and phagophore assembly, framed as cargo delivery to autophagosomes for degradation.

theme: Bone formation and RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are skeletal tissue formation (ossification, osteoblast development, cartilage, tendon, sutures), framed as the RUNX2-directed osteoblast programme.

theme: Gonadotropin-regulated ovarian follicle development and ovulation
core_role: The shared pathways are FSH/LH-driven follicle growth and oocyte maturation and gonadotropin secretion control, framed within the reproductive hormone axis including activin/follistatin, ovulation and luteinization.

theme: Craniofacial and limb embryonic morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are embryonic morphogenesis of the face and limbs, framed as mesenchyme-driven craniofacial (palate, head) and appendage patterning.

theme: Pentose phosphate and hexose sugar interconversion
core_role: The shared pathways are central sugar-phosphate interconversions (non-oxidative pentose phosphate, fructose, glucuronate, glycerol, gluconeogenesis) and their inborn errors, framed as feeding pyruvate/alanine-linked central metabolism.

theme: Drug and xenobiotic membrane transport (ADME)
core_role: The shared pathways are SLCO and efflux transporter-mediated drug uptake and export, framed as the transport step of drug ADME including organic cation transport.

theme: Kidney development: nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephrogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, framed as the inductive tissue that drives metanephric nephron development.

theme: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism (phase I/II)
core_role: The shared pathways are drug/toxin biotransformation enzymes (CYP, FMO, acetylation, sulfonation), framed as general xenobiotic metabolism extended to ethanol and steroid oxidation.

theme: Centrosome positioning and mitotic spindle orientation
core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome positioning and microtubule nucleation/anchoring at the MTOC and cortex, framed as the basis for spindle positioning and asymmetric division in mitosis.

theme: Rh glycoprotein gas and ammonium transport
core_role: The shared pathways are Rh-family ammonium and CO2 transport and its erythrocyte defect, framed within red cell gas exchange (O2/CO2/NO transport).

theme: Lipoprotein-driven macrophage foam cell formation
core_role: The shared pathways are lipoprotein uptake, signalling and cholesterol storage in macrophages, framed as atherogenic foam cell formation in response to oxidised LDL.

theme: NF-kB activation via TLR and TNF receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are IKK complex recruitment through TLR-IRAK-TRAF6 and RIP1, framed as canonical NF-kB activation shared with TNFR1 ubiquitin-dependent signalling.

theme: Androgen and estrogen nuclear receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are sex steroid receptor (AR, ER) transcriptional responses and chaperoning, framed as steroid hormone signalling including prostate epithelial control and progesterone/testosterone responses.

theme: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon
core_role: The shared pathways are RIG-I/MDA5 and cytosolic DNA sensing leading to IRF3-driven type I IFN, framed as the innate antiviral response that viruses evade.

theme: Heavy metal response and metallothionein detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are the MTF1-metallothionein response to metal ions (zinc, copper, mercury, iron), framed as heavy-metal detoxification including cadmium.

theme: Ras-MAPK signalling, feedback control and RASopathy mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are Ras-RAF-MEK-ERK activation and its GAP/phosphatase negative feedback including disease mutants, framed as the core MAPK module downstream of growth factor receptors.

theme: Ribosomal RNA transcription and nucleolar growth control
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of RNA polymerase I/III rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin, including MYC targets, framed as ribosome biogenesis supporting growth.
